description: Kiro-style chat redesign + welcome screen + nav restructure (all frontend, fully testable in vitest). (1) Bottom-anchored composer with controls as compact inline icons instead of a wall of controls above the input: inline model selector, inline routing-mode control, 'Why this model?' as an info icon/tooltip, and a warning-icon->modal for provider enumeration errors (removing the always-on red error text). (2) Default landing view = a Welcome screen (large logo + intro + prominent 'New conversation' button); the chat surface renders ONLY when a conversation is active. (3) Conversations become a SUB-LIST under the 'Chat' nav item (Chat > [conversation list + New conversation]); keep History and Settings. This feature also adds the composer ICON SLOTS (Attach, Repository, Web-search toggle) as UI affordances wired to no-op/handlers that FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 flesh out, so the layout lands once. Preserve v0.7.4: threaded chat, send-failure alert (sendState/sendError), Enter-to-send / Shift+Enter (IME-safe), Stop button semantics.
steps: app.tsx: change the main pane so that when destination==='chat', it renders the chat surface (MessageList + Composer + PermissionPrompt) ONLY when useConversationsStore activeConversationId !== null; otherwise render a new WelcomeScreen component. Remove the standalone <RoutingModeToggle /> that currently sits between MessageList and Composer (its function moves INTO the composer as a compact inline control - see below). Keep the single top-level onCoreEvent effect and the startup providers load() EXACTLY as-is (do not tear down or duplicate the subscription).

Create hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/features/chat/WelcomeScreen.tsx: a large Agent Harbor logo (reuse `import logoUrl from '../../assets/logo.svg'` exactly like app.tsx brand), a short intro line, and a prominent primary 'New conversation' button. The button creates a conversation via useConversationsStore.createConversation() then opens it via openConversation(created.id) so the chat surface appears. Use a distinct region aria-label (e.g. aria-label="Welcome") and design tokens (var(--ah-*)); no hard-coded colors. Add a data-testid on the logo (e.g. welcome-logo) and give the button an accessible name 'New conversation'.

Restructure the sidebar in app.tsx: keep NAV_ITEMS Chat / History / Settings, but render the Conversations list nested UNDER the Chat nav item (a 'Chat' group whose expanded body contains the conversation list + a 'New conversation' action), replacing the current `{destination==='chat' &&
}` block. Extract the conversation list + New conversation affordance into a small reusable piece (reuse ConversationList + NewConversationButton from features/history) so History (the standalone destination) and the Chat-nested sub-list share the same list rendering. Selecting a conversation from the sub-list must call the store open/resume path so the chat surface opens; creating one opens it too. With none selected, the main pane shows WelcomeScreen (NOT the old 'No conversation selected' shell).

Create hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/features/model-selector/InlineModelControl.tsx (or extend the composer): a COMPACT inline control living inside the composer that shows the effective 'providerId / model' (e.g. 'ollama-local / qwen3:8b') as a small dropdown/menu (▾). It reuses the providers store `models` and the conversations store pin/override path already used by ProviderModelPicker/PerMessageOverrideControl - do NOT duplicate the override-ownership logic; read/write the SAME shared pendingOverride / conversationPref values. Group Local vs Cloud as ProviderModelPicker does. Keep the existing PerMessageOverrideControl semantics (override applies to exactly one message) but present them compactly. When there are zero models, show a single compact 'No models' affordance (do not stack multiple NoModelsEmptyState blocks - preserve the existing single-guidance invariant tested in app.test.tsx).

Fold routing mode (Auto / Prefer Local / Prefer Quality / Manual) into a small inline control in the composer (a compact dropdown or small segmented control), NOT four large tabs. Reuse the exact store actions from RoutingModeToggle (setConversationRoutingMode, setConversationRoute for the Manual pin, the pin-implies-Manual derivation). You may refactor RoutingModeToggle into a compact variant or a shared hook; keep the radiogroup semantics/aria for tests but shrink the visual footprint. The Manual pin picker should reveal the inline model picker rather than a big block.

'Why this model?' rationale: convert the always-on AutoRationaleTooltip body text into an INFO ICON (button) in the composer area that reveals the rationale on click/hover (a tooltip/popover). Reuse getRouteExplanation via the existing AutoRationaleTooltip data path; just change presentation to icon-triggered. Give the trigger an aria-label like 'Why this model?'.

Errors -> warning icon -> modal: replace the always-on red ProviderEnumerationErrors text near the picker with a WARNING ICON (⚠️) button in the composer area shown ONLY when the providers store `errors` array is non-empty (zero errors => no icon). Clicking it opens a SMALL MODAL listing each ProviderEnumerationError (providerId + message). Also surface the store `lastError` (failed load) in the same modal if present. Keep a small 'Refresh models' ICON button (aria-label 'Refresh models') calling providers store load(). Create hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/features/model-selector/EnumerationErrorModal.tsx (or a composer-local modal). The modal must be dismissible and use role="dialog" with an accessible name; the trigger button aria-label e.g. 'Show model load warnings'. Update/keep ProviderEnumerationErrors usage in Settings (ProviderKeysSection) unchanged if still referenced there, or ensure the Settings/Diagnostics surfaces still show errors as before (do not regress the Diagnostics panel).

Composer.tsx layout: make the composer BOTTOM-ANCHORED with a compact control row IN/AROUND the input box. Left/inline controls: Attach (📎, aria-label 'Attach file'), Repository (📁, aria-label 'Add repository context'), Web-search toggle (🌐, aria-label 'Toggle web search', aria-pressed reflecting on/off state). Add the inline model control, inline routing-mode control, the 'Why this model?' info icon, the warning icon (conditional), and the small Refresh icon. Keep Send + Stop with their existing semantics and the existing 'Failed to send' role=alert affordance and Enter/Shift+Enter handler EXACTLY. In THIS feature the Attach/Repository handlers may be minimal placeholders (e.g. local state stubs) that FEAT-003 wires to the dialog + backend; the Web-search toggle stores an on/off flag in composer/local or a store field that FEAT-004 consumes. Give each input/control an explicit aria-label (help-text-wrapping bug guard).

CSS: add the necessary classes to hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/styles/app.css for the bottom-anchored composer, the icon control row, the welcome screen (large centered logo), the modal, and the Chat-nested sidebar sub-list. Use only var(--ah-*) tokens from tokens.css; add new tokens to tokens.css (both light and dark) if a new color/size is needed. Do not introduce a component library.

Update/extend tests: app.test.tsx (welcome screen shows by default when no active conversation; chat surface region appears only after a conversation is opened; Conversations nested under Chat; the single-subscription + startup-load invariants STILL hold; the single-no-models-guidance invariant STILL holds; add any NEW commands the redesign calls to routeInvoke and initialize any NEW store fields in the two setState resets). Add tests for the composer icon row (Attach/Repository/Web-search toggle present with correct aria-labels), the inline routing-mode control (radiogroup still switches modes), the 'Why this model?' info icon reveals rationale, and the warning-icon->modal (no icon when errors empty; modal lists errors when present; Refresh calls load). Update chat.test.tsx and model-selector.test.tsx for the moved/compact controls. Ensure every mounting test mocks ALL invoke commands with well-formed shapes and uses await findBy*/waitFor after state changes.
acceptance_criteria: On first launch (no active conversation) the main pane shows the Welcome screen with a large logo and a 'New conversation' primary button; the chat surface (region name 'Chat') is NOT rendered until a conversation is active.
Clicking 'New conversation' (welcome or sidebar) creates+opens a conversation and the chat surface then renders.

The sidebar shows Conversations nested under the Chat nav item (Chat > list + New conversation), plus History and Settings nav items; the old always-visible 'Conversations' side section under Chat is replaced by this nested sub-list.

The composer is bottom-anchored with compact inline controls: inline model selector, inline routing-mode control (Auto/Prefer Local/Prefer Quality/Manual), a 'Why this model?' info icon (rationale on click/hover), Attach/Repository/Web-search toggle icons, Send, Stop, and a small Refresh-models icon. The four large routing-mode tabs and the always-on rationale paragraph are gone.

Provider enumeration errors are no longer always-on red text near the picker: a warning icon appears ONLY when errors exist and opens a small role=dialog modal listing each providerId+message (and lastError if set); with zero errors there is no icon.

v0.7.4 behavior preserved: threaded MessageList, 'Failed to send: <reason>' role=alert on a rejected send, Enter-to-send / Shift+Enter newline (IME-safe), Stop button disabled/labelled as today, and exactly one no-models guidance block in the chat pane.
All frontend tests pass (vitest), tsc is clean, eslint has no unused-vars, prettier check passes; every mounting test mocks all invoke commands and initializes all new store fields in resets.
verification: Run the frontend vitest suite (npm run test) and confirm all tests pass, including the new welcome-screen / nested-conversations / composer-icon-row / warning-modal / inline-routing tests. If node_modules is absent in-sandbox, this gate is CI-only: do an exhaustive manual self-review that every mounting test's routeInvoke covers all called commands and both setState resets include any new store fields.
Run tsc (npm run build or tsc --noEmit), eslint, and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` and confirm clean; otherwise document as CI-only after manual review.
Manually trace app.tsx render paths to confirm the chat surface is gated on activeConversationId and the welcome screen renders otherwise.
